note: Fictional albums and artists with original SVG artwork. Builder seeds these eight records exactly once; cover is optional presentation metadata (null for user-created albums, which receive a generated typographic sleeve).

albums.title: Salt Lines
albums.notes:
Recorded in a boathouse on the Firth over one winter. The tape hiss is part of the arrangement.

Best track: “Ebb Register”. Play it loud with the window open.

albums.title: Night Shift at the Observatory
albums.notes: Side A is patient, almost too patient. Side B opens up when the vibraphone enters at 4:10.

albums.title: Concrete Orchard
albums.notes: Found the sleeve in a Kōenji shop window. Heard it is city pop filtered through brutalist field recordings.

albums.title: Second Weather
albums.notes: Synths that sound like barometric pressure. Better on headphones than speakers.

albums.title: Halfway to Pelagos
albums.notes: Liner notes say it was written for a ferry crossing. Keep notes literal: <brass> & <tide> are not tags.

albums.title: The Long Room Sessions, Vol. II: Recorded Live at the Harbour Assembly Hall, Winter Residency
albums.artist: The Calder Fielding Chamber Orchestra & Choir of St. Brennan’s
albums.notes:
Two discs. Disc one is the residency programme as performed; disc two collects the encores and a rehearsal take of the Brennan Canticle that was never meant to be released.

My copy has a small seam split on the spine.
